items.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate (SPP) of China announced on Monday that it has started investigation into Sun Zhengcai, former secretary of Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC).

items.title: Xi stresses nonstop efforts to fight undesirable work styles
items.summary: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, stressed that the fight against undesirable work styles should not be stopped.

items.title: World's largest automated container terminal starts operation in Shanghai
items.summary: As part of the Shanghai Free Trade Zone, the system can operate completely unmanned.

items.title: China launches communication satellite for Algeria
items.summary: China launched Algeria's first communication satellite, Alcomsat-1, into a preset orbit from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center in the southwestern province of Sichuan early Monday.

items.title: Chinese, Algerian presidents hail successful launch of communications satellite
items.summary: President Xi Jinping and his Algerian counterpart Abdelaziz Bouteflika exchanged congratulatory messages on the successful launch of Alcomsat-1 in the Xichang Satellite Launch Center in China's southwestern province of Sichuan early Monday.

items.title: Autopsy: Jiang suffered several injuries before the fatal stab
items.summary: The trial of the alleged murderer of Chinese student Jiang Ge began at 10 am on Monday in Tokyo. It will last seven days and the verdict is expected on Dec 20.

items.title: Asia's tallest wooden pagoda destroyed
items.summary: The 16-story structure was said to be the tallest wooden pagoda in Asia. No casualties were reported in the incident. The cause of the blaze is under investigation.

items.title: Guizhou: Western province looks to the future of big data
items.summary: While located in the remote southwestern part of China, Guizhou leads the development of Big Data technology in recent years.

items.title: Is it a Risk for America that China Holds So Much U.S. Debt?
items.summary:
Many worry that China’s ownership of American debt affords the Chinese economic leverage over the United States. This apprehension stems from a misunderstanding of sovereign debt and of how states derive power from their economic relations.
